description: This file defines a Java class `RawConfigSupplier` that implements the `Supplier<Config>` interface. Its purpose is to determine the appropriate configuration (`Config`) to load based on environment variables indicating whether the service is running in CloudFoundry, Docker, or development mode. The class provides methods for creating instances with a specific service name and uses fallback configurations loaded from resource files to assemble the final configuration.

classes.name: RawConfigSupplier
classes.description: A final class that supplies configuration based on environment detection, intended for use within an Eclipse Ditto-based service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of RawConfigSupplier for a given service name, ensuring the name is not null.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the computed Config object based on environment variables and resource fallbacks.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves environment-specific configuration using an environment variable-based supplier.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificBaseConfig
methods.description: Loads base configuration related to the specific service from resource files.
